The five banks operate through their head offices and branches, conducting deposit, lending, domestic exchange and foreign exchange operations, among others. All five banks are consolidated subsidiaries in which the company holds 100% of voting rights (as of March 31, 2026). The head offices of The Bank of Fukuoka, The Fukuoka Chuo Bank and Minna Bank are in Chuo-ku, Fukuoka City; that of The Kumamoto Bank is in Chuo-ku, Kumamoto City; and that of The Juhachi-Shinwa Bank is in Nagasaki City. The Bank of Fukuoka and The Juhachi-Shinwa Bank each account for more than 10% of consolidated ordinary income. Because ordinary income from external customers in the banking business exceeds 90% of consolidated ordinary income, amounts by service are not disclosed.
